title: Spec Kit for Codex: architecture and workflow routing
description: Shows the local Codex plugin's language boundaries and its greenfield and brownfield paths.

diagrams.title: Plugin architecture and language boundaries
diagrams.accessibility: Codex loads the local marketplace package. Markdown skills call a Go read-only MCP shim, which reads pinned Spec Kit and Brownfield command references. The Python CLI initializes a target project only after approval; Codex file tools create reviewed artifacts.
diagrams.source:
flowchart LR
  marketplace["Local Codex marketplace\nJSON manifest"] --> plugin["Spec Kit plugin\nportable plugin.json + mcp.json"]
  subgraph plugin_parts["Plugin package"]
    skills["Codex skills\nMarkdown workflow guidance"]
    shim["Read-only MCP shim\nGo + official MCP SDK"]
  end
  subgraph upstream["Pinned upstream submodules"]
    specify["GitHub Spec Kit\nPython CLI + templates"]
    brownfield["Brownfield extension\nMarkdown commands + YAML metadata"]
  end
  subgraph target["Selected target project"]
    init["specify init\nPython CLI via uv"]
    artifacts[".specify/ and specs/\nCodex-approved project artifacts"]
  end
  skills -->|"read-only tool calls"| shim
  shim -->|"fixed command references"| specify
  shim -->|"fixed command references"| brownfield
  skills -->|"reviewed setup command"| init
  init --> artifacts
  skills -->|"approved edits"| artifacts

diagrams.title: Greenfield and brownfield workflow gates
diagrams.accessibility: A read-only project status check routes new work to the core workflow and existing projects to a read-only Brownfield scan. Brownfield adoption initializes Spec Kit only when needed after approval, then requires approval for bootstrap and one-feature-at-a-time migration.
